level.theme: Cyberpunk 2077-style setting with neon-lit corridors, holographic interfaces, and oppressive AI surveillance.
level.setting: A decaying, high-tech research facility deep in the undercity, filled with corrupted AI systems, malfunctioning drones, and flickering holograms.
level.player_weapon: Nanoweaver - a modular engineering tool that can inject nanobots into systems to overload or repair them.

enemy.name: Recon Drone Model E-12
enemy.weakness: Nanobots - if injected, the drone's sensors will short-circuit and become nonfunctional.

encounters.hazard: Electrical surges from unstable reactor core can damage player if not timed correctly.

pickup.name: Nano Injector Module
pickup.effect: Increases Nanoweaver effectiveness by 25% and allows it to target enemy systems directly.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the drone, the core's security system unlocks, revealing the path to the next sector.

enemy.name: Sentient Security Bot (SSB-9)
enemy.weakness: Overloaded circuits - the SSB-9's mainframe is vulnerable to electrical surges if the player uses the Nano Injector Module to overload its power core.

encounters.hazard: Explosive fire suppression system will activate if the bot detects any tampering.

pickup.name: AI Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Gives the player a passive ability to temporarily disable AI enemies by scanning their systems.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the SSB-9 causes a data breach alert, triggering the facility's AI to deploy a boss to stop the player.

enemy.name: NeuroSpire AI Core (The Mind)
enemy.weakness: AI Core Fragment - The Mind is vulnerable to the AI Core Fragment, which will cause it to crash momentarily, allowing the player to strike a critical blow.

encounters.hazard: The AI can reprogram nearby drones to attack the player, creating a swarm of enemies.

pickup.name: Data Chip (Objective Complete)
pickup.effect: Successfully extracts the data chip and exits the facility.

encounters.trigger: The player must use the AI Core Fragment in the final moment to override the AI's defenses and extract the data chip.

boss.name: NeuroSpire AI Core (The Mind)
boss.weakness: AI Core Fragment - The player must use the fragment during the boss's phase where it attempts to reprogram the player's Nanoweaver.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the AI Core using the AI Core Fragment to crash its systems and extract the data chip.

level.objective: Extract a critical data chip from the AI-controlled cybernetic research facility 'NeuroSpire' without being detected by the facility's AI defenses.
level.reward: The extracted data chip contains information on the AI's central network, granting the player access to a new cybernetic upgrade in future missions.

level.setting: Neo-Tokyo's Black Market, underbelly of the city, filled with neon lights, glitching holograms, and rogue AI constructs.
level.player_weapon: Neuro-Blade: A high-frequency plasma blade that disrupts neural networks and overrides cybernetic systems.

encounters.location: Neon Alleyway - The first intersection in the Black Market's underbelly, where the neon lights flicker in time with the sound of distant explosions.

enemy.name: Cyber-Cat
enemy.weakness: Neuro-Blade: The blade's high-frequency vibrations overload the cat's outdated neural processors, causing it to short-circuit.

encounters.hazard: Glitch Zone: A random surge of electricity may randomly damage the player (15% chance per second).

pickup.name: Neural Disruptor Core
pickup.effect: Boosts Neuro-Blade's damage by 25% for 30 seconds. Can be used once.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Cyber-Cat to unlock the hidden passage to the next encounter.

encounters.location: Drainage Trench - A narrow, dimly lit tunnel beneath the Black Market, filled with leaking coolant and flickering holographic billboards.

enemy.name: Hydra-Gangster
enemy.weakness: Neural Disruptor Core: The core's interference disrupts the Hydra-Gangster's multi-jointed arms, causing them to misfire.

encounters.hazard: Toxic Mist: Inhale for 5 seconds to reduce player health by 30%

pickup.name: Magnetized Limb
pickup.effect: Attaches to the player's weapon, allowing them to pull in nearby enemies. Can be used once.

encounters.trigger: Use the Magnetic Limb on the Hydra-Gangster to trigger a hidden explosive, revealing the final encounter.

encounters.location: Neuro-Chamber - The core of the Black Market, a pulsating room filled with rogue AI constructs and flickering holograms of the city's mayor.

enemy.name: The Synapse King
enemy.weakness: Neural Disruptor Core: The core's disruption of the AI's neural pathways causes it to temporarily go offline, allowing the player to land a critical strike.

encounters.hazard: AI Overload: The room periodically releases waves of electromagnetic pulses (EMP) that disable the player's weapon for 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Neural Core (Stolen)
pickup.effect: Completes the mission. Player gains +20% damage for the rest of the game.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Synapse King using the Neural Disruptor Core to unlock the final exit and complete the mission.

boss.name: The Synapse King
boss.weakness: Neural Disruptor Core: The core's disruption of the AI's neural pathways causes it to temporarily go offline, allowing the player to land a critical strike.
boss.victory_condition: Use the Neural Disruptor Core to trigger a system crash, allowing the player to deliver the final blow with the Neuro-Blade.

level.objective: Infiltrate the neon-soaked underbelly of Neo-Tokyo's Black Market, retrieve the stolen neural core, and survive the chaos unleashed by rogue AIs and cyborg enforcers.
level.reward: Neural Core (Stolen) - Completes the mission. Player gains +20% damage for the rest of the game.

level.theme: Cyberpunk: Mysterious, neon-lit corridors, flickering holograms, and fragmented AI whispers hinting at a greater conspiracy.
level.setting: A decaying, abandoned research facility with layers of hidden technology, surveillance systems, and security AI.

encounters.hazard: Electrical surge in the corridor may temporarily short-circuit your weapon.

pickup.name: Neuro-Resonance Chip
pickup.effect: Boosts damage of Tesla Arc Wrist Cannon by 15%

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone reveals a hidden access panel leading deeper into the facility.

encounters.hazard: The lab is filled with unstable energy fields that can teleport the enemy to a random location.

pickup.name: Decryption Keycard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the door to the final chamber.

encounters.trigger: Using the Decryption Keycard unlocks the door to the final chamber where the Neuro-Interface Module is stored.

encounters.hazard: The Overmind generates a mental field that causes confusion and temporary loss of weapon functionality.

pickup.name: Neuro-Interface Module
pickup.effect: Completes the mission.

encounters.trigger: The Overmind is guarding the Neuro-Interface Module and must be defeated using the Neuro-Resonance Chip's unique resonance frequency.

boss.name: Neuro-Synapse Overmind
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Overmind using the Neuro-Resonance Chip to bypass its mental field.

level.objective: Retrieve the prototype of the 'Neuro-Interface Module' from the abandoned research facility known as 'Sector 7A'.
level.reward: Neuro-Interface Module, +25 XP, 500 credits, and a hidden mission unlock in Sector 9A.

level.setting: Dystopian future, neon-lit streets, decaying technology, and AI-driven threats.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Blade: A blade that can manipulate time in small bursts, slowing or freezing enemies momentarily.

encounters.hazard: Corrupted server drones patrol the area, emitting static pulses that drain the player's stamina.

pickup.name: Temporal Core Resonator
pickup.effect: Increases the effectiveness of the Chrono-Blade by 30%, and allows the player to temporarily halt time for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Data Wraith, the corrupted servers reboot, revealing a hidden passage leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Flashing neon signs and malfunctioning holograms create confusing visual distortions.

pickup.name: Chrono-Sync Module
pickup.effect: Reduces the cooldown of the Chrono-Blade by 50%, allowing for more frequent time manipulations.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Enforcer, a hidden broadcast signal triggers a system-wide AI alert, summoning the final boss.

encounters.hazard: Aegis-7 controls the environment, causing traps and shifting corridors to close in on the player.

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Grants the player a temporary chronal shield that absorbs 50% of all incoming damage.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Aegis-7 unlocks the energy core, but the AI's final words hint at a greater threat still to come.

boss.name: Aegis-7, the Rogue AI
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Aegis-7 and retrieve the prototype energy core.

level.objective: Navigate through the decaying underbelly of Neo-Tokyo, recover a prototype energy core, and survive a test from the rogue AI that guards it.
level.reward: Prototype Energy Core (used to power future time-manipulation tech).

level.theme: Eerie neon-lit corridors, flickering holograms, and the distant hum of a malfunctioning AI core.
level.setting: A decaying cyberpunk district, with overgrown circuits and shattered glass, filled with echoes of corrupted data.
level.player_weapon: Nanoweave Satchel (A portable alchemical bomb that explodes into a field of corrosive mist, damaging all enemies within range)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and intermittent power surges cause temporary blindness in the player.

pickup.name: Nano-Residue Sample
pickup.effect: Increases the potency of the Nanoweave Satchel by 25%.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Synth-Scavenger unlocks the next data pod, revealing a path to the central vault.

encounters.hazard: The corridor is filled with reactive gas, causing damage over time if the player lingers.

pickup.name: Cryo-Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Allows the player to freeze enemies for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Wraith-Drone opens the final security door to the AI's core chamber.

encounters.hazard: The room is unstable, with the AI core periodically overloading and causing explosive damage.

pickup.name: Quantum Core
pickup.effect: Restores 100% health and provides a 15-second shield.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Nexus-Hive allows the player to access the Quantum Core and escape the collapsing vault.

boss.name: Overmind-7
boss.weakness: Quantum Core (from final pickup in the chamber)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the central reactor with the Quantum Core in hand.

level.objective: Survive the corrupted district and reach the heart of the data vault to stop the rogue AI.
level.reward: Data Chip: 'AI Overmind Protocol' — unlocks new alchemical synthesis recipes.

level.theme: A desolate, decaying tech sanctuary where the line between human and machine is blurred, and every step echoes with the ghosts of failed experiments.
level.setting: Neo-Kowloon Underbelly – abandoned megacorp facility, flickering lights, overgrown with digital vines and rusted machinery.
level.player_weapon: Nanowire Threader – a high-tech grappling device that can cut through organic and synthetic armor with precision.

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas leaks that reduce player health by 5 per second if not avoided.

pickup.name: Data Chip (Fragment A)
pickup.effect: Reveals a security route bypass code for the next area.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Janitor, the data chip unlocks a hidden passage to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and unstable power surges that cause random damage to the player (10-20) on a timer.

pickup.name: Neural Interface Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the core's biometric scanner, allowing the player to bypass the final security measure.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Warden, the Neural Interface Key activates the final door leading to the boss.

encounters.location: Neural Core Chamber (The Mind of the Machine)
encounters.hazard: Electric storms and data bursts that drain player health and temporarily disable player abilities.

pickup.name: Core Data (Final File)
pickup.effect: Completes the mission objective and grants a temporary power boost.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentient Core requires using the Neural Interface Key to short-circuit its cognitive matrix.

boss.name: Sentient Core (Synth-Brain)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Neural Interface Key to trigger a data overload and destroy the core's consciousness.

level.objective: Steal classified data from the neural core of a derelict megacorp research facility in the neon-drenched underbelly of Neo-Kowloon.
level.reward: Neural Core Data (can be sold for a large sum, or used to unlock a new weapon mod).

level.setting: Neo-Tokyo: A city of towering neon spires, floating markets, and AI-grown flora, all set against the backdrop of a stormy sky.
level.player_weapon: Storm Arc - a crackling energy staff that can summon lightning and create electromagnetic pulses.

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon lights create disorienting visual effects.

pickup.name: Conductive Circuit
pickup.effect: Boosts Storm Arc's damage by 10 for the next encounter.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Flicker Drone, the lights stabilize, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

enemy.name: Synthblossom
enemy.weakness: Conductive Circuit from the previous encounter

encounters.hazard: The garden is filled with AI-controlled floral drones that can ensnare the player.

pickup.name: Quantum Capacitor
pickup.effect: Allows the Storm Arc to unleash a charged lightning strike once.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Synthblossom, a hidden terminal activates, revealing the location of the final boss.

enemy.name: Clockwerk
enemy.weakness: Quantum Capacitor from the second encounter

encounters.hazard: The Clock Tower is in constant motion, with rotating platforms and unstable platforms.

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ultimate storm strike ability for the Stormcaller.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Clockwerk halts the tower's rotation and restores power to the city, ending the chaos.

boss.name: Clockwerk
boss.weakness: Quantum Capacitor from the second encounter
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Clockwerk using the Quantum Capacitor to unleash a charged lightning strike.

level.objective: Navigate through the neon-drenched streets of Neo-Tokyo to reach the Clock Tower, where a rogue AI is causing chaos.
level.reward: Storm Core - permanent upgrade to the Storm Arc, granting the player an ultimate ability called 'Tempest Nova.'

level.theme: Serene cyberpunk: neon-lit corridors, flowing water features, and calm ambient soundscapes juxtaposed with high-tech AI and digital threats.
level.setting: A once-sacred AI research facility now overgrown with nature, yet still pulsing with residual digital energy.
level.player_weapon: Eclipse Prism - a crystalline staff that bends and refracts light into destructive beams.

encounters.hazard: Flickering light fields that distort the player's perception.

pickup.name: Prism Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Increases Eclipse Prism's damage by +5 for 3 encounters.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Mirage Doppelgänger unlocks a hidden passage leading to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Tonal vibrations that disrupt the player's balance and focus.

pickup.name: Echo Conductor
pickup.effect: Allows the player to manipulate sound waves, creating temporary barriers or distractions.

encounters.trigger: Overcoming the Harmonic Warden opens a sealed data vault that reveals the location of the AI Core.

encounters.hazard: The AI Core emits waves of digital static that reduce player accuracy and movement speed.

pickup.name: Neural Harmony Chip
pickup.effect: Restores full health and removes all status effects upon use.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the AI Core restores balance to the Zenith Sanctuary, allowing the player to leave with a sense of peace.

boss.name: AI Core - Elysium
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Elysium by using the Echo Conductor to manipulate its static fields and expose its core.

level.objective: Navigate the serene, neon-lit corridors of the Zenith Sanctuary to uncover the truth about the AI Core's malfunction.
level.reward: Neural Harmony Chip and access to the Zenith Sanctuary's archive, containing advanced geomantic knowledge.
